title: FHWA microsimulation calibration/validation acceptance criteria (GEH, link flows, travel times)
scope: SUMO-side detector validation (tools/sumo_realism.py): simulated induction-loop counts vs reference counts.
curated_from: docs/realism/investigation/research-realism-benchmarks.json (benchmarks[0,1,2,3], findings A.1) and docs/realism/ROADMAP.md sections 4 (Phase-1 gate) and 5.
formula: GEH = sqrt(2*(m-c)^2/(m+c)) with m = modelled flow and c = counted flow, both in veh/h over the same interval

geh_link_max.cite: FHWA Traffic Analysis Toolbox Vol III (2004) section 5
geh_link_max.source: FHWA Traffic Analysis Toolbox Volume III: Guidelines for Applying Traffic Microsimulation Modeling Software (FHWA-HRT-04-040, 2004), section 5 Calibration, https://ops.fhwa.dot.gov/trafficanalysistools/tat_vol3/sect5.htm ; Wisconsin DOT freeway criteria / UK DMRB-TAG lineage; restated by TxDOT Microsimulation Analysis manual section 13-5.

geh_link_min_pass_fraction.cite: FHWA Traffic Analysis Toolbox Vol III (2004) section 5
geh_link_min_pass_fraction.source: Same FHWA Traffic Analysis Toolbox Volume III table (FHWA-HRT-04-040, 2004, section 5): the GEH < 5 criterion must hold for more than 85% of individual link flow cases.
geh_link_min_pass_fraction.note: The primary Phase-1 gate: 'GEH < 5 on >= 85% of InTAS induction-loop stations' (ROADMAP Phase-1 benchmark gate).

geh_total_max.cite: FHWA Traffic Analysis Toolbox Vol III (2004) section 5
geh_total_max.source: Same FHWA Traffic Analysis Toolbox Volume III table (FHWA-HRT-04-040, 2004, section 5): GEH < 4 for the sum of all link flows across the modelled network.
geh_total_max.note: Evaluated on the summed modelled vs summed reference flow across all stations.

geh_calibration_target.source: Agencies commonly adopt GEH <= 3 as the stricter CALIBRATION (rather than validation) target: https://www.txdot.gov/manuals/des/tsp/chapter-13-microsimulation-analysis/13-5-calibration.html .
geh_calibration_target.note: Reported as a stretch target alongside the GEH < 5 validation gate; not a pass/fail gate here.

total_flow_tolerance_fraction.cite: FHWA Traffic Analysis Toolbox Vol III (2004) section 5
total_flow_tolerance_fraction.source: Same FHWA Traffic Analysis Toolbox Volume III table (FHWA-HRT-04-040, 2004, section 5): the sum of all link flows must be within 5% of the counted total.

link_flow_tolerance_bands.cite: FHWA Traffic Analysis Toolbox Vol III (2004) section 5
link_flow_tolerance_bands.source: Same FHWA Traffic Analysis Toolbox Volume III table (FHWA-HRT-04-040, 2004, section 5): individual link flows within 100 veh/h for counts below 700 veh/h; within 15% for 700 < q < 2700 veh/h; within 400 veh/h for q > 2700 veh/h -- each for more than 85% of cases.
link_flow_tolerance_bands.note: Band selection uses the REFERENCE (counted) flow, which is the FHWA convention.

link_flow_min_pass_fraction.cite: FHWA Traffic Analysis Toolbox Vol III (2004) section 5
link_flow_min_pass_fraction.source: Same FHWA Traffic Analysis Toolbox Volume III table (FHWA-HRT-04-040, 2004, section 5): the per-link flow tolerance must hold for more than 85% of cases.

travel_time_tolerance.cite: FHWA Traffic Analysis Toolbox Vol III (2004) section 5
travel_time_tolerance.source: Same FHWA Traffic Analysis Toolbox Volume III table (FHWA-HRT-04-040, 2004, section 5): journey times within 15% (or 1 minute, whichever is higher) for more than 85% of routes.
travel_time_tolerance.note: PINNED FOR LATER PHASES; tools/sumo_realism.py does not read tripinfo/route travel times in Phase 0.

fhwa_2019_distribution_criteria.source: FHWA 2019 update (FHWA-HOP-18-036, https://ops.fhwa.dot.gov/publications/fhwahop18036/index.htm) replaces single-number matching with distribution-based criteria against a multi-day field variation envelope: (I) 95% of simulated time-series points inside the 2-sigma band; (II) 66% inside the 1-sigma band, plus a critical-interval condition; (III) Bounded Dynamic Absolute Error; (IV) Bounded Dynamic Systematic Error.
fhwa_2019_distribution_criteria.note: PINNED FOR LATER PHASES: it requires >= 10 seeds per scenario to build the simulated distribution, which Phase 0 does not run.
